The audit is complete and PR opened: **https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/606**

Summary of findings (full detail in `ai-os/audits/reporting_module_reaudit_2026-07-27.md`):

- **PR #601** (compliance-tracker CSV gateway) and **PR #51** (projexa pivot/chart UI) are both real, merged, correctly tested/typechecked, and carry genuine `AUDIT: PASS` verdicts — their own narrow scopes hold up.
- But the broader "genuinely 100% complete" question is **INCOMPLETE-WITH-GAPS**:
  1. A separate, pre-existing unescaped CSV-export path still exists in `src/app/(app)/reports/page.tsx`'s dashboard "Export CSV" button — a real formula-injection bypass that PR #601 never touched.
  2. The "real, automated cross-org tenant-isolation penetration test" named as the task's own top priority doesn't actually exist at the database/RLS level anywhere in the codebase — only a mocked-DB unit test.
  3. Projexa's pivot/chart E2E test has never actually run, due to a self-disclosed, still-unresolved production login-routing bug; no CI job exercises it either.

Updated `PROGRESS.md`, committed, pushed, and opened the PR containing the report — task complete.
